scientific_integrity: Analytic result for explicitly defined zero-temperature two-qubit Lindbladian; full stationary generator reconstructed and independently checked; numerical diagnostics supplement rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Identical strictly positive spontaneous-emission rates and joint Poisson ground resetting; no thermal pumping, detuning, individual resetting, or many-qubit conclusion. Earlier reset-assisted entanglement and unreset dissipative phenomena are not claimed as new; publication-priority comparison is bounded.
title: A sharp entanglement-rescue boundary and optimal concurrence envelope under collective resetting with spontaneous emission
